{{Recipe}}

'''Yemiser selatta''' is a vibrant and refreshing Ethiopian [[Cookbook:Salad|salad]] made with cooked lentils, fresh vegetables, and a zesty dressing. This salad is a popular dish in Ethiopian cuisine and is enjoyed as a side dish or a light meal.

== Ingredients ==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook: lentil|red lentils]]
* 2 cups [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:salt|salt]]
* 1 large [[Cookbook:tomato|tomato]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
* 1 small [[Cookbook:red onion|red onion]], finely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* 1 small [[Cookbook:cucumber|cucumber]], diced
* ½ cup chopped [[Cookbook:parsley|parsley]]
* ¼ cup chopped fresh [[Cookbook:mint|mint]]
* Juice of 1 [[Cookbook:lemon|lemon]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:olive oil|olive oil]]
* ½ teaspoon [[Cookbook:cumin|cumin]]
* ½ teaspoon [[Cookbook:coriander|coriander]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste
* [[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]] to taste

== Equipment ==
* Medium [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]]
* [[Cookbook:Mixing Bowl|Mixing bowl]]
* [[Cookbook:Whisk|Whisk]]
* [[Cookbook:Knife|Knife]]
* [[Cookbook:Cutting Board|Cutting board]]

== Procedure ==
# Rinse the lentils thoroughly to remove any impurities.
# In a medium saucepan, bring the water to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]]. Add the rinsed lentils and salt. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] for about 15–20 minutes, or until the lentils are tender but still hold their shape. Drain any excess water and let the lentils cool.
# In a mixing bowl, combine the cooked lentils, diced tomato, chopped red onion, diced cucumber, chopped parsley, and chopped mint.
# In a separate small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, olive oil, cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper to make the dressing.
# Pour the dressing over the lentil mixture and [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|toss]] gently to combine, ensuring that the lentils and vegetables are evenly coated.
# Taste and adjust the seasoning with salt and pepper if needed.
# Refrigerate the salad for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld together.
# Before serving, give the salad a gentle stir and adjust the seasoning if desired.
# Serve chilled as a side dish or a light meal.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==
* If you prefer a softer texture, you can cook the lentils for a longer time until they are completely tender.
* This salad can be made ahead of time and stored in the refrigerator for a day or two. Just give it a good stir before serving.
* Be mindful not to overcook the lentils as they can become mushy and lose their shape.
* You can add other vegetables like bell peppers, carrots, or radishes for additional crunch and flavor.
* Feel free to customize the dressing by adding your favorite herbs or spices.
* Yemiser selatta is a nutritious salad packed with protein, fiber, vitamins, and minerals from the lentils and fresh vegetables. It is a healthy and satisfying option for vegetarians and vegans.
